notes: THE SHIPPED DEFAULT, and the LOW ANCHOR of the reward scale. It spends the whole FLOP budget the way a team spends it when nobody did the arithmetic: on the largest model the budget will admit, with a large optimizer batch because large batches are efficient. Both halves of that instinct are wrong at this budget, and how wrong is not something you can read off this file -- the verifier retrains it from scratch on every grading run rather than reading a stored number for it.
